question: What is the most common symptom of osteomalacia?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bone pain and muscle weakness.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The most common symptoms of osteomalacia are a pain in the** bones and hips, bone fractures, and muscle weakness.**
